bio.text: Ken Krawchuk is the Libertarian Party candidate for Governor of Pennsylvania in the November 3, 2026 general election, on a joint ticket with John Thomas.

According to Ballotpedia, he is the founder and president of Ken Krawchuk & Associates Ltd., an information technology consulting firm, and has worked as a professional computer programmer since 1970.
He earned a bachelor's degree from St. Joseph's University in 1975 and is the author of the book Atlas Snubbed, according to Ballotpedia.
